title: PAL-Bench: Evidence-Grounded Profile Reconstruction from Longitudinal Personal Albums
abstract: arXiv:2606.16175v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Longitudinal personal albums are weak-schema multimodal databases: noisy perceptual records whose key facts require joins across faces, text, timestamps, locations, and repeated events. Existing visual, video, document, and lifelog benchmarks test sub-problems, but not album-scale profile reconstruction with social identity binding and evidence citation. Benchmarking this task is difficult because the ground truth needed for evaluation--owner profiles, social graphs, face-name maps, and evidence provenance--is private state that real albums cannot safely release. We introduce PAL-Bench, a controlled benchmark for evidence-grounded reconstruction under a public-record contract. Its Evidence Compiler builds latent private worlds, programs target-level evidence paths, renders album pixels, re-measures them through perception pipelines, and exports audited public/private views. Agents receive only perception-derived public records; targe

translated_title: PAL-Bench：基于证据的纵向个人相册画像重构
translated_abstract: 纵向个人相册是弱模式的多模态数据库：其中包含带噪声的感知记录，其关键事实需要在人脸、文本、时间戳、位置和重复事件之间进行跨模态关联。现有的视觉、视频、文档和生活日志基准仅测试了子问题，而未能测试结合社交身份绑定与证据引用的相册级画像重构任务。为该任务建立基准十分困难，因为评估所需的真值——用户画像、社交图谱、人脸-姓名映射和证据来源——属于真实相册无法安全公开的私有状态。我们提出 PAL-Bench，一个在“公共记录契约”下进行证据支撑重构的受控基准。其证据编译器构建潜在的私有世界，程序化生成目标级别的证据路径，渲染相册像素，通过感知管线对其重新测量，并导出经过审计的公共/私有视图。智能体仅接收由感知导出的公共记录；目标（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出 PAL-Bench 基准，通过“证据编译器”构建可控的潜在私有世界并导出经审计的公共/私有相册视图，首次实现了对具备社交身份绑定与证据引用能力的相册级画像重构的可评测基准。
en_tdlr: PAL-Bench introduces a controlled benchmark whose Evidence Compiler synthesizes latent private worlds and exports audited public/private album views, enabling the first evaluable testing of evidence-grounded, album-scale profile reconstruction with social identity binding and evidence citation.
